ingredientSections.heading: The Meatery Porchetta
items: 1-1.5kg Homemade hot or mild Italian sausage (see recipe on previous page) or your favorite type of good quality pre-made sausage

methodSections.heading: The Meatery Porchetta
steps: Ask your butcher to butterfly pork belly when you purchase it. Lay it flat on counter rind side up.
With a sharp blade score a diamond pattern in the fat being careful not to cut through into the flesh.

Flip the belly rind side down. If you are using pre-made sausage remove the meat from its casings. Shape sausage meat into a cylinder that fits the width of the belly and place on one end. Roll the sausage meat up in belly.
Tie roast with cooking string at 2-3cm (1in) intervals and firmly push any escaping sausage meat into the end of the roll. Pat rind dry with paper towel and rub generously with salt.

Place on baking paper on a roasting tray and cook at 150°C (300F) for two hours in a convection oven (if using a non-convection oven add an extra 30 minutes) or until the internal temperature reaches 75°C (160F). Then blast at 200°C (400F) for 15 minutes to crisp the rind.
Let rest for 30 minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite roast vegetables and make sandwiches with apple-slaw out of the leftover's.
